> **0.2.9** is 0.2.8 packed under L'Cronx (plugin folder `L'Cronx - VST - LXRXXL BAZZLINE`); nothing else changed. Uninstall 0.2.8 first.

LXRXXL BAZZLINE for MPC OS 3.x (Akai Force / MPC), armv7. Unzip, then follow INSTALL.md (root SSH access, e.g. MockbaMod).
`LXRXXL-BAZZLINE-<version>-mpc-armv7.zip` is the plugin; `LXRXXL-BAZZLINE-<version>-source.zip` its complete source
(required by the LXR02 Open-Source license: non-commercial use only).
Tested on a device when listed in tested.json (a pre-release until then). See CHANGELOG.md for what changed.
